title: Eleven Years of Tuesdays
subtitle: 音乐之声 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 音乐之声（文学艺术与体育·音乐与表演）
meta: 主题语境：音乐之声（文学艺术与体育·音乐与表演）　|　核心词汇：band　|　正文 327 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 band 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1955 my father joined ① a band that rehearsed in a room above a shop, and my mother said the room was the whole of the marriage. The ② band, meaning the six men and not the music, met on Tuesdays for eleven years and never once played a wedding; a band, he said, is the only club that exists to be almost good.

Every ③ band in that town wanted the same Friday, and the ④ band from the next street, meaning the one with the trumpet and not either of those, got it every year until March. A band, my grandmother said, is nine parts loyalty and one part somebody who can count; my father said the loyalty is the part that costs.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ band was the whole of the evening, meaning the noise and not the six men. The ⑥ band, meaning the sound and not any of that, is the only thing in a hall that everybody hears and nobody listens to; a band, he said, is either a group of men or the only argument you can dance to. She said the dancing is the forgiving half.

By 1967 the ⑦ band had become a photograph above the shop, and the photograph had become an argument about who had left first. The ⑧ band of the whole thing, my father wrote in May, was eleven years of Tuesdays and one broken trumpet; a band, he said, is either the men in the room or the reason you learned to count. She said counting was the useful part.

The ⑨ band I remember is the six men, two of whom were still arguing in 1971 and neither of whom could remember the tune. A ⑩ band, my mother said in 1973, is the only thing that improves by being almost finished; every band, she said, is a Tuesday that has agreed to look like music. She said the music was never the point.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: B. n. 乐队（指那六个人，与音乐相对）
C. 固定搭配：join a band 加入一支乐队
D. n. 乐队（指镇上每一支）
E. n. 乐队（指隔壁街那支）
F. n. 乐队（指整个夜晚的喧闹）
G. n. 乐队（抽象：那种声音）
H. n. 权衡；整件事的分量（抽象总称）

items.q: a band that rehearsed in a room above a shop
The band, meaning the six men and not the music
the band from the next street
band was the whole of the evening
the band had become a photograph above the shop
The band of the whole thing
A band, my mother said in 1973

answers.why: join a band 意为“加入一支乐队”，1955 年父亲加入了一支在店铺楼上排练的乐队。
band 意为“乐队”，指那六个人而不是音乐，他们每个星期二聚一次，聚了十一年。
band 指镇上每一支乐队，那个镇上每一支都想要同一个星期五。
band 指隔壁街那支乐队（有小号的那一支），它年年都拿到，直到那年三月。
band 意为“乐队”，指整个夜晚的喧闹，叔叔说它就是一个夜晚的全部，指的是那阵吵闹声。
band 为抽象用法，指那种声音，是大厅里人人都听见、却没人真正去听的东西。
band 意为“乐队”，到 1967 年这个 band 成了店铺楼上的一张照片。
band 意为“权衡、整件事的分量”，父亲五月写道，整件事权衡下来是十一年的星期二和一支坏掉的小号。
band 意为“乐队”，我记得的是那六个人，其中两位到 1971 年还在吵。
band 为抽象总称，母亲说乐队是唯一会因为几乎散伙而变得更好的东西。
